title: WHIL’s Picture of the Week
content:
21st January 2014 

This was taken about 2 years ago during a spring/summer look-book shoot for a high end ladies footwear company called Seven Boot Lane, based in Wells, Somerset.

Sometimes you get lucky during a shoot, this particular time we were lucky enough to bump into some horse riders along the beach who were happy to lend one of their horses while they were taking a rest.

Seven Boot Lane fact: Pippa Middleton is regularly spotted wearing a pair!

Thanks for taking a look, Will.
 

As always, we’re interested in getting our reader photos as Photo of the Week. If you have any images you’d like to share with the world (well, mainly Bristol) please send them to contact@thefixmagazine.com with the subject ‘Photo of the week’.

Will Fahy
